About Aeroflex Industries Limited
AEROFLEX INDUSTRIES LIMITED, is a Public Listed Company incorporated in the year 1993 and engaged in the business of Metal Fabricating. As per the latest available financials filed by the company for the year Mar 2026, the total paid-up capital is INR 259 million and Authorized capital is INR 560 million. The last Annual General Meeting (AGM) of the company was held on 05 July, 2024 and the company has filed their last balance sheet for the period ending on Mar 2026.

The registered office address of this company is Survey No.-41 42/13 42/14 42/18, Village Chal Panvel, Near Midc Taloja, Mumbai, Maharashtra - 410206, Email: corporate@aeroflexindia.com.

As per the records, the Auditor(s) of the company : Shweta Jain & Co - Mumbai(Statutory), D M Jain & Co - Thane(Internal), T F Khatri & Associates - Mumbai(Secretarial Audit), S K Jain & Co - Mello Road Fort - Mumbai(Secretarial Audit), Rampurawala Mohammed A & Co(Cost Auditor)
